title: Audit R3-final correction to the governed async replan provider — canonical Objective budget admission reconciles outstanding reservations AND settled-but-unaccounted spend (flag unchanged, default OFF)
description: Audit R3-final on PR #118: the R3 check excluded all SETTLED rows assuming their actual cost was already inside canonical consumed_microusd, but settlePlannerInvocation/settleFromResult can settle without any OBJECTIVE_BUDGET_ACCOUNTED event — a settled 80µ with consumed=0 let a second 80µ admit under ceiling=100. The admission txn now keeps SETTLED liability unless the spend is PROVABLY accounted: the canonical correlation is spend_key === reservation_id in the strict-verified applied_spend_keys ledger (accountBudget is key-idempotent; reservation_id is the idempotent key). used = consumed + HELD/COMMITTED reserved + SETTLED-unaccounted; must fit ceiling else FAIL_CLOSED_COST_OBJECTIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Settled+accounted rows are excluded exactly once (no double-count); RELEASED frees; zero-budget/unbounded/legacy-lineage/idempotent-replay semantics unchanged.
